notes.title: Bug Fix Update – Files Brought Up to Date
notes.content: Game files have been updated due to a reported bug. Some players have experienced missing promotion panel and chess clock not stopping during promotion moves. We haven’t been able to reproduce this issue in testing, so it’s likely caused by outdated files. This update doesn’t add new features — it simply ensures the latest file versions are in use.

These are generated according to the PGN standard, based on the selected time control. Since this is a relatively complex feature, some bugs may still appear — feel free to report anything odd you notice.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]graveyard animation[/b] for captured pieces has been tweaked for a more polished and visually pleasing look.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor bug fixes[/b] and small improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]If you try to [b]drag a piece outside the board[/b], it now smoothly snaps back to its original position after a small buffer zone.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🎯 Major Improvements to UI, Animations & AI – New Just Chess Update Out Now!
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]To be honest – I’m scared of bugs. But I don’t see any obvious ones this time... so I’m shipping it![/p][p]The latest Just Chess update includes a wide range of improvements and fixes aimed at making the experience smoother, clearer, and more enjoyable for all players – whether you're just starting or playing at a high level.[/p][p]🔧 [b]Key Fixes and Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Time bonus is now correctly applied after move animations, regardless of whether you drag or click.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved piece animations: pieces – especially knights – now maintain the correct orientation.[/p][/*][*][p]Smoother dragging with threshold detection to prevent accidental micro-movements.[/p][/*][*][p]Chess clocks now properly start after using the Continue button.[/p][/*][/list][p]🕒 [b]New Time Control Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a popular format: [b]Rapid 25+10[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI move animation speed now adapts based on the selected time control.[/b] Slower games feature more deliberate, immersive animations, while faster formats keep things snappy and responsive.[/p][/*][/list][p]🤖 [b]AI & Gameplay Adjustments:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Okay, I’ll admit it: I may have over-optimized the [b]internal engine[/b]… and it ended up being [i]too[/i] strong for beginner players. [b]The fix?[/b] We added a touch of randomness to its move selection at lower levels! Now, instead of always playing the perfect move, the engine sometimes makes more human-like choices – especially around level 1000 and below. This makes the game feel more approachable and enjoyable for new players.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to thinking-phase AI handling.[/p][/*][/list][p]🧠 [b]Demo Game Enhancements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]While the demo game (autoplay) is running, you can pause it simply by moving the mouse, and continue playing from that point yourself.[/p][/*][*][p]Demo game is now reliably interruptible and resume-ready.[/p][/*][*][p]FSM system rebuilt for better control and stability.[/p][/*][*][p]StopAI calls ensure the engine doesn’t get stuck after interruptions.[/p][/*][/list][p]💾 [b]Save & Continue Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Time-controlled games now reload as untimed, allowing use of Undo/Redo.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-restart now requires mouse movement, preventing accidental game starts when away.[/p][/*][/list][p]🎨 [b]Small UI & Visual Tweaks:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Restart animation no longer plays if no moves have been made.[/p][/*][*][p]Added distinct events for button arrivals during restart animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Flip (F) key instruction added to the in-game help.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple polish-level improvements to interface and movement visuals.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Clock and Time Control Fixes
notes.content:
We've deployed an update that addresses several important issues related to the game clock and official time controls, making timed games more accurate, fair, and intuitive.

1. Time Controls Now Add Time Correctly
We identified and fixed a critical bug in how multi-stage time controls (like FIDE's "90 minutes for 40 moves, then 30 minutes added") were handled. In some cases, the additional time was awarded one move too late.  We also corrected some underlying data values in the time control presets to ensure they match their descriptions.

2. Clock Display Improved for Clarity
We've also fixed an issue where the visual clock display could be misleading. Previously, if you gained time from increments and your total time went above the starting amount, the radial timer would appear "stuck" at 100%. With this update, the clock now intelligently treats your highest achieved time as the new "100%" mark. This means you will always see the clock visually ticking down during your turn, giving you a much more accurate sense of your time situation at a glance.

3. Consistent Time Bonus (Increment)
Finally, we fixed a logic error where the player's clock would behave differently from the AI's clock regarding increments. The time bonus is now applied consistently to both the player and the AI.

notes.title: Major Update – Chess Clocks, New Time Controls, and UI Improvements!
notes.content:
[p][b]Just Chess now supports timed games![/b]
This update introduces full chess clock functionality, complete with a wide range of popular time controls, as well as major UI improvements and gameplay refinements.[/p][h3]🕐 Available time controls:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Bullet:[/b] 1+0, 1+1, 2+1[/p][/*][*][p][b]Blitz:[/b] 3+0, 3+2, 5+0, 5+3[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rapid:[/b] 10+0, 10+5, 15+10[/p][/*][*][p][b]Classical:[/b] 30+0, 30+20, 90/40, 120[/p][/*][*][p][b]Untimed mode[/b] is also available[/p][/*][/list][p]At this time, custom time settings are not available, but a carefully curated list of common formats has been added for a varied and familiar experience.[/p][h3]♟ Gameplay changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Undo and Redo[/b] are [b]disabled in timed games[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New move speed setting for the chess engine[/b] is available in Settings
→ Use it to simulate more realistic time usage by the engine
→ Combined with difficulty settings, it can help simulate time pressure and even allow time victories against the engine in a satisfying way[/p][/*][*][p]Piece [b]move animations[/b] have been improved for a more natural look and feel[/p][/*][/list][h3]⏰ 2D and 3D Clocks[/h3][list][*][p]You can toggle between [b]2D and 3D clocks with the C key[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]3D clocks[/b] use a circular progress diagram over a clock face to represent remaining time[/p][/*][*][p][b]2D clocks[/b] include a spinning indicator when the engine is thinking[/p][/*][*][p]No sound effects in clocks yet – might be added later[/p][/*][/list][h3]🖥️ UI Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Captured pieces (graveyards)[/b] are now visible on both sides of the board, regardless of which side you're playing[/p][/*][*][p]Other 2D UI elements are hidden under the graveyards during gameplay and only appear when you move the mouse outside the board[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flip View button[/b] added (toggle board side):[/p][list][*][p]Use [b]F[/b] key or click the new button[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Reset View button[/b] added:[/p][list][*][p]Use [b]R[/b] key to reset to your default playing side[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3][p]Most bugs fixed in this update were related to the UI. The new timed mode should now work smoothly – but if you encounter any issues, [b]please report whether you were using the UCI or Internal engine[/b], and whether you were playing with or without a time limit.[/p][p]We hope this update improves your experience and adds more excitement and value to your games. Thank you for playing![/p]

notes.title: Small Update: Self-Playing Chess Engine
notes.content:
Just Chess has received a small but hopefully entertaining addition! With this update, the game can now play a match against itself. If the board is empty and the player has been inactive for a while, the engine will automatically start a self-play game where it controls both sides.

The self-play stops immediately if the player moves the mouse.

This update should not interfere with normal gameplay. Our hope is that this little feature adds a bit of liveliness and fun to the game when it's idle.

Thanks for playing Just Chess!

notes.title: Update 4.04 – Small UI Tweak
notes.content: This minor update hides the board UI elements automatically when the game starts. You can still toggle them using the H and E keys or the mouse.

notes.content:
[list]
[*] The active side indicator can now be hidden along with the rest of the UI using the H key.

notes.title: Update: Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
PGN listing corrected to follow the official PGN specification (Result tag shows 1-0, 0-1, 1/2-1/2, or *). 

Added a UI indicator on both sides of the board to better show whose turn it is.

Fixed a bug where Steam achievements were not unlocking properly.

notes.title: Chess Game Update: UI Enhancements and Bug Fixes for Chess Engine
notes.content: The game has received an update with changes to the UI button colors for a better user experience. Additionally, a bug fix has addressed issues with the chess engine's difficulty and time settings not being properly transmitted. The fix may lead to increased CPU usage on higher difficulty levels.

notes.title: Update: ELO Strength Rating Removed from UI and PGN
notes.content: In this update, all mentions of the strength rating have been removed from the UI and PGN notation. The chess engine's strength is now displayed simply as a level ranging from 500 to 3100.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content: The board UI elements can now be hidden with the H key, and the ELO difficulty slider has been revamped with an improved color scheme for a more pleasant experience.

notes.title: New Update: 5 New Steam Achievements Added!
notes.content:
We've added 5 new Steam achievements! You can now earn achievements by defeating your opponent 10 times at the following ELO levels:

🏆 1000
🏆 1500
🏆 2000
🏆 2500
🏆 3000

Can you conquer them all? Good luck!

notes.title: Small Update: Steam Achievements Added and Lighting Improved
notes.content: A small update: 27 Steam achievements have been added and are now available. Additionally, the scene lighting has been adjusted slightly to improve user experience.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content: A small update: It is no longer possible to achieve a new record if the match has been saved and loaded. The game must be played through in one continuous session. A UI icon displaying volume has also been added, along with the ability to adjust the volume using the arrow keys.
